lead.description: the probability of an event about an unknown after the data have been taken into account

self_checks.title: Equal unnormalised weights
self_checks.prompt: Prior probabilities are 1/4 and 3/4, and the sampling probabilities of the sample are 1/2 and 1/6. What is the posterior probability of the first explanation?

self_checks.title: Equal prior probabilities
self_checks.prompt: The sampling probabilities stay 1/2 and 1/6, and the prior probabilities are both 1/2. What is the posterior probability of the first explanation?

overview_sentence: A [posterior probability](articles/posterior-probability.qmd) is the probability of an event about an unknown after the data have been taken into account.
